attacks.claim: Migration 0042 runs in place against prod and drops positions.roll_history in the same transaction, which irreversibly destroys all roll history older than 90 days. It also removes the data the stated fallback path depends on, so rolling back to roll_eod.py is not possible once the migration commits.
attacks.evidence: "Migration 0042 runs in-place against prod Monday 08:00 ET"; "Backfill copies roll_history entries from the last 90 days into rolls; older entries are not needed by roll_engine."; "In the same transaction, ALTER TABLE positions DROP COLUMN roll_history."; "roll_eod.py stays deployed behind ROLLER_V2=false as the fallback path through week 4." ABSENT: any statement that roll_eod.py does not read roll_history, any pre-migration backup or snapshot, and any rollback or restore procedure.
